title: Digital Solution Specialist  - Mumbai
description:
Identifies, develops, manages and retains revenue\-generating opportunities for the organization through the strategic and tactical sales and support of all product and service lines. Directly, or indirectly, manages the process from lead validation to product and services delivery, working with marketing, customer service, operations and delivery providers to ensure the highest level of supply chain management is delivered to customers. This job family is intended to accommodate 1\) jobs whose accountabilities span two or more job families within the job group; 2\) jobs that are not covered by a defined job family within the job group; 3\) managerial roles spanning more than one family that are not broad enough in scope and impact to be assigned to the Business Unit/General Management job family within the Management job group.
   

  

**Job Requirements**
**Responsibilities:**
* Meets monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets while ensuring timely accounts receivables by aligning with Finance AR Team.
* Provide in depth training, education, onboarding, and Marketing support to customers for Ormco’s digital portfolio suite, Spark Aligners.
* Provides quick response and resolution to customers' queries.
* Establishes a track record of converting key brand business to Ormco’s digital product suite.
* Understands and support the company's sales training policies and procedures to provide proper and effective treatment to all the company's customers.
* Relates new product ideas and product extensions to Marketing for evaluation.
* Creates and utilizes sales and educational strategies, aids, and approaches, to increase customer utilization and educational activity in their territory.
* Follows corporate policies regarding customer entertainment and customer relations while being compliant with the organizational and regulatory norms.
* Develops and fully utilizes territory management tools to include account coverage and fiscal management. This would include block plan organization and budget compliance.
* Reviews and reports complaints received from customers and recommends corrective action through established reporting guidelines.
* Collects and reports competitive information to Marketing Management.
* Prepares periodic reports including weekly call reports, weekly expense reports, periodic general reports, and other reports as assigned.
* Displays or demonstrates product, using all necessary selling aids and clinically established techniques to emphasize salable features and benefits.
* Estimates date of delivery to customer, based on knowledge of company's production and delivery schedules.
* Prepares reports of business transactions and maintains expense accounts.
* Maintains all reporting requirements under established guidelines


**Desired Work Experience, Education \& Skills**
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English
* Experience: 5\+ years Orthodontic Industry Experience in a sales or training role.
* Education: Graduate degree in either: dentistry, medicine, science or engineering preferably with MBA.


**Other Desired Skills**
* Strong organizational skills with proven time management skills.
* Ability to work independently and creatively.
* Excellent communication skills including verbal and written.
* Demonstrated ability to develop on\-going professional relationships with customers.
* Be able to educate and nurture customers during the learning phase
* Result orientated.
* High level of agility and ability to manage internal \& external stakeholders.


 Operating company:Ormco

Envista will consider unsolicited referrals and/or resumes submitted by vendors such as search firms, staffing agencies, professional recruiters, fee\-based referral services and recruiting agencies (Agency) to have been referred by the Agency free of charge and Envista will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt such unsolicited resumes. title: Key Account Management - Nurturing
description:
Role: Key Account Manager \- Corporate Channel
   

  

 Level: Manager
   

  

 Reporting To: Director \- Corporate Channel
   

  

 Location: Mumbai
   

  

**About The Function**
 MyBiz, a corporate travel management platform by MakeMyTrip, provides a customizable, real\-time self\-booking system that seamlessly integrates into a company’s structure to deliver convenience, transparency, savings, and the power of choice. Over the last five years, it has onboarded 50,000prominent corporates who are benefiting from the platform’s seamless experience and significant cost savings.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Business Growth \& Account Expansion: Focus on driving revenue growth by increasing wallet share across existing large accounts. It includes activating new Lines of Business (LOBs) within client organizations and fostering deeper process integration to position the company as a strategic partner. This approach ensures that client relationships evolve beyond transactional engagements into long\-term, value\-driven partnerships.
* Client Delight \& Retention: Emphasize seamless servicing and operational excellence across all client touchpoints. It involves building and nurturing multi\-level relationships within client organizations to deepen engagement and trust. Additionally, it requires proactive exception management and swift issue resolution to maintain high satisfaction levels and ensure zero client churn.
* Strategic Client Engagement: Execute through structured, meaningful interactions—such as Quarterly Joint Business Reviews (JBRs)—to align on performance and identify future opportunities. The role involves crafting tailored engagement strategies for each key account to ensure continuous value delivery and alignment with client objectives. These efforts help strengthen trust, uncover growth potential, and reinforce the company’s position as a long\-term strategic partner.
* Leadership \& Team Development: Demonstrate strong leadership through people engagement, data\-driven decision\-making, and a focus on operational excellence. The candidate is expected to mentor and empower the team, fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement. A key success factor is effective cross\-functional collaboration with the operations, supply, and product teams.


**Qualification \& Experience**
* Postgraduate from a reputed institute with 6–9 years of relevant experience in Key Account Management, Customer Success, or Strategic Client Engagement.
* Proven experience in conducting Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs/JBRs) and managing multilevel client relationships while driving customer satisfaction and business growth.


**Key Success Factors For The Role**
* Demonstrated expertise in commercial levers such as commission structures, discounting strategies, and foundational P\&L management
* Data\-driven decision\-maker with a strong analytical mindset and a proven ability to navigate complex business challenges
* Influential communicator with the ability to engage, align, and build trust across senior stakeholders and cross\-functional teams
* Confident presenter with the ability to articulate strategic narratives and drive executive\-level conversations

title: Key Account Manager - VIP Accounts
description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building Tomorrow, today**
 At CoinDCX, we believe ‘CHANGE STARTS TOGETHER’. You are the driving force that will help us make Web3 accessible to all.
   

  

 In the last six years, we have skyrocketed from being India’s first crypto unicorn to carrying a community of over 125 million with us. To continue maximising the adoption and acceleration of Web3, we are now focused on developing cutting\-edge products, addressing accessibility and security challenges, and bridging the gap between people and Web3 technologies.
   

  

 While we go ahead and keep dominating the Web3 world, we would like to HODL you on our team! Join our team of passionate innovators who are breaking barriers and building the future of Web3\. Together, we will make the complex simple, the inaccessible accessible, and the impossible possible. Boost your innovation to an ALL TIME HIGH with us!
   

  

**About The Role**
 This isn’t a typical Sales role.
   

  

 You will work on initiatives that genuinely transform how finance works in India, a type of work few roles offer.
   

  

 Build and nurture relationships with VIP customers actively trading options on CoinDCX. Engage users through calls and personalised communications, sharing updates on new listings, product launches, market developments and trading features to drive engagement, retention and satisfaction.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Drive VIP Trader Engagement: Build and own relationships with high\-value Options Traders through personalised engagement, delivering timely updates on options products, listings and market opportunities.
* Drive Product Penetration: Identify trader needs and lead cross\-sell and adoption of relevant CoinDCX options and derivatives products.
* Own Trading Growth \& Retention: Monitor trading activity and volumes, design targeted interventions to reactivate traders and deliver sustained trading engagement.
* Deliver Market \& Product Insights: Build trader trust by sharing actionable insights on options strategies, volatility, market trends, margin and product developments.
* Drive Trader VoC: Own the feedback loop with active traders and collaborate with Product, Research and Operations to design and deliver a superior options trading experience.


**You’ll Excel in This Role If You**
* Think like a trader: Stay curious about markets, options, volatility and trading behaviour.
* Learn fast, execute faster: Absorb new concepts quickly and turn learning into action.
* Think analytically: Use data to identify patterns, opportunities and trader behaviour.
* Own the outcome: Take end\-to\-end ownership of tasks and follow through with minimal hand\-holding.
* Have a bias for action: Move quickly, experiment, and iterate based on results.
* Communicate with clarity: Present insights and ideas in a simple, structured and actionable way.
* Stay customer\-obsessed: Understand the needs of options traders and continuously look for ways to improve their experience.


**You’ll Know You’re Winning When**
* Improved user retention: Contributed to initiatives that improve retention and reactivation of active Options Traders.
* Increased trading volumes: Delivered measurable growth in options trading activity and user volumes within the assigned cohort.
* Improved trader engagement: Built and executed targeted initiatives to increase engagement among high\-value Options Traders.
* Delivered actionable insights: Generated data\-backed insights on trader behaviour, churn, and product adoption to support growth initiatives.


**Why This Role Matters \& What’s In It For You**
* Build from the ground up : Be part of the first major experiment focused on VIP Options as a product.
* Own \& lead : Get meaningful ownership to shape initiatives, experiment with new ideas and drive outcomes.
* High\-impact exposure : Work closely with Options Traders, Product, Research and business teams to understand and build for a fast\-evolving market.
* Make your mark : Your work can directly influence how VIP Team builds and scales its Options business.


**Hiring Process**
 Here’s what your journey with us looks like:
   

  

* Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
* Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better
* Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem\-solving
* Assignment / Simulation Round – A take\-home task or live problem\-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios
* Culture \& Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best


**Where We Work**
 We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.
   

  

 With this belief, we operate as a work\-from\-office organisation. This role is based out of our Mumbai office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.
   

  

**Perks That Empower You**
 We believe great people deserve great experiences.
   

  

* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources
* Learning Sessions: Bi\-weekly learning and growth opportunities


**Ready to Build What’s Next?**
 If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high\-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it.
   

  

 Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

title: Senior Account Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 AZB \& Partners, founded in 2004, is a leading full\-service law firm providing reliable and practical legal advice across sectors. The firm has steadily expanded and now operates offices in Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, Chennai, and Pune, with a team of over 600 lawyers. AZB \& Partners is known for its strong understanding of legal, regulatory, and commercial environments in India and globally, enabling tailored counsel for diverse clients. Its client portfolio includes domestic and international companies, Fortune 500 entities, MNCs, investment banks, and private equity firms, supported by strong relationships with regulators and international law firms. The firm has earned significant national and international recognition, including top rankings by RSG and Band 1 ratings across multiple practice areas from Chambers Asia\-Pacific and Chambers Global.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Senior Account Manager will oversee key client relationships, ensuring high\-quality service delivery and proactive management of client needs. This full\-time, on\-site role based in Mumbai involves acting as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, coordinating with internal legal teams, and supporting matter management and billing activities. The Senior Account Manager will track client engagements, prepare account reviews and reports, and identify opportunities for cross\-selling and business development. The role includes managing client communication, addressing inquiries and feedback, and maintaining accurate records and documentation. The Senior Account Manager will also contribute to process improvement, support firm\-wide initiatives, and help strengthen long\-term client partnerships.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Demonstrated experience in key account management, client servicing, or relationship management within professional services, preferably legal or consulting.
* Strong skills in communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and conflict resolution.
* Ability to analyze client data, prepare reports, and use CRM or similar tools for tracking engagements and performance.
* Organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to handle multiple accounts and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Collaborative mindset with experience working closely with cross\-functional teams, including lawyers, finance, and business development.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, management, law, or a related field; advanced qualifications or MBAs are an advantage.
* Prior experience in large law firms or complex corporate environments is highly desirable.
* Complete knowledge of GST including compliance.
* Foreign Vendor Payments, DTAA, Withholding Tax implications,
* High level of professionalism, integrity, client\-centric approach, and discretion in handling confidential information.

title: Account Manager
description:
**We’re reinventing the market research industry. Let’s reinvent it together.**
 At Numerator, we believe tomorrow’s success starts with today’s market intelligence. We empower the world’s leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it.
   

  

**Job summary:**
 Are you inquisitive, creative, hardworking, and driven? Do you enjoy leading a team?
   

  

 If you are, we are looking for an Account Manager to be part our team passionate about bringing compelling levels of insights to our partners and ensuring the long\-term revenue growth for Worldpanel India.
   

  

 This is an exciting role which will provide you with a blended development focus from on\-the\-job experience, exposure and exchange of knowledge with others, and more formal education as you look to take the next step in your career.
   

  

**WHAT YOU’D DO:**
**Client Partnership**
 Establish rapport with your clients to drive and grow the day\-to\-day relationship with them by learning and understanding their business, key objectives and challenges.
   

  

 Work with a range of client functions from sales teams to insight teams and even board level
   

  

**Client Servicing**
 Deliver and monitor contractual obligations and client satisfaction, handling issue resolutions and implementing improvements as identified
   

  

 Handle relevant training activities for the Clients
   

  

**Commercial Growth**
 Assists the Account Director in monitoring the group’s annual revenue commitments and contribute to team revenue performance by identifying areas of opportunity to develop our service further with your client and producing relevant proposals.
   

  

 Take part on assigned projects which help driving further the expertise and business expansion of Worldpanel in India.
   

  

**Insights Generation**
 With your team, ensure the production of appropriate analyses and presentations in response to briefs/requests received from clients
   

  

 Deliver astute presentations with insights/ recommendations that sharply meet the objectives of the brief and applicable to clients’ business.
   

  

**Team Leadership**
 Active role in mentoring and developing junior team members \- sharing knowledge, encouraging a culture of learning.
   

  

**What You'll Bring to Numerator**
**WHAT YOU’D BRING:**
* 4\-7 years working experience in Market Research \- ideally in FMCG industry
* A curious mentality and unafraid to have a point of view.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills which can be applied in a commercial context.
* Professional and courteous in manner, dedicated to providing a good level of service and motivated to find solutions for problems.
* Articulate and credible written and verbal communication skills, being comfortable in presentation to large audiences.
* Able to cope well with time pressure and make decisions in fast paced circumstances
* Excellent client servicing skills and enjoys establishing relationships
* Be able to work effectively in a team environment and independently
* Well organized with strong level of time management and the ability to optimally plan the workload for own and a small team.
* Good command of computer skills, proficient in MS PowerPoint, Excel and Word
* Knowledge of various statistical and analytical techniques and/or tools is an advantage.
* Demonstrates intellectual and professional integrity.
* Good networking skills and service orientation.
* Strong desire to motivate and develop others
* The candidate will possess a bachelor’s degree.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Account Manager with strong hands\-on experience in Network Security, Firewall technologies, and team leadership. The ideal candidate will be an individual contributor as well as a team manager, capable of driving complex projects while also mentoring and managing a team of Network Security Engineers and Consultants.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage end\-to\-end network security projects across global enterprise environments.
* Act as a technical subject matter expert on Palo Alto Networks, FortiGate, Cisco Firewalls, and Load Balancers (Citrix/F5\).
* Design, implement, and manage security rules and configurations on Palo Alto and FortiGate firewalls.
* Troubleshoot Layer 4 and Layer 7 application and connectivity issues.
* Oversee Global Protect VPN configurations and support.
* Manage firewall backups and recovery operations for business continuity.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to define project scope, objectives, timelines, and deliverables aligned with PMP and ITIL frameworks.
* Develop and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for configuration changes and operational processes.
* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of network security engineers and consultants, ensuring high\-quality project delivery.
* Interface with clients, vendors, and internal teams to present project status, security recommendations, and risk assessments.
* Lead and mentor a team of network security engineers and consultants.
* Allocate tasks, review configurations, and guide the team to ensure quality and timely delivery.
* Conduct training and upskilling sessions for team members on security best practices and tools.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across network security operations.


**Basic Qualifications**
* A Bachelor’s or Master's in one of: Computer Science or Related filed.
* 8\+ years of overall experience in Network Security and Project Management.
* Strong hands\-on expertise with Palo Alto or FortiGate firewalls and Load Balancers (F5/Citrix).
* In\-depth understanding of Network Security, Firewalls, VPN, and advanced troubleshooting at L4\-L7\.
* Proven experience managing global security infrastructure projects.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of ITIL processes, change management, and incident/problem management.
* Experience in creating security rules, policy updates, and access control configurations.
* PCNSA (Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Administrator)
* PCNSE (Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer)
* NSE4 (Fortinet Network Security Expert Level 4\)
* Citrix (Networking / ADC)


**Why Gruve**
 At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Head - Partner Success and Performance Management (PSS08110)
description:
**About The Company**
 A technology\-driven platform with a wide\-reaching presence across India, supported by an extensive network of customers, partners, service providers, and distribution channels. The organisation is focused on scalable growth, strengthening its partner ecosystem, and leveraging data to enhance business performance and governance.
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 The
 **Head \- Partner Success and Performance Management** 
 role exists to establish disciplined partner governance, transparent reporting, and structured engagement across the complete partner ecosystem. This leadership position is responsible for converting MIS into actionable insights, running governance cadences, securing action closure, and improving service, customer, and business outcomes. The role reports directly to the
 **Head CX** 
 .
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design a common governance framework covering partner segmentation, KPIs, SLAs, review frequency, escalation paths, and decision rights.
* Create differentiated engagement models based on partner size, criticality, performance, geography, and customer impact.
* Maintain a central partner repository including scope, contracts, locations, contacts, SLAs, scorecards, review history, and open actions.
* Own a single source of truth for partner MIS; ensure data accuracy, consistency, validation, and on\-time publication.
* Build automated dashboards for volumes, TAT, SLA, ageing, quality, productivity, cost, customer experience, escalations, and action closure.
* Publish daily, weekly, and monthly reports with trends, root causes, risks, exceptions, and management actions using Advanced Excel and Power BI/Tableau.
* Partner with Data and Technology teams to automate extraction, alerts, and scorecards, reducing manual reporting.
* Establish and run operational huddles, weekly reviews, monthly business reviews, and quarterly business reviews with defined agendas and participants.
* Prepare fact\-based review packs covering performance trends, customer feedback, risks, decisions, and improvement actions.
* Document actions with accountable owners, timelines, and outcomes; maintain rigorous follow\-through and escalation until closure.
* Define partner\-specific scorecards aligned to business commitments and customer expectations.
* Identify performance deviations early and initiate recovery plans before they affect customers or commercial relationships.
* Benchmark partners and recommend load allocation, incentives, penalties, probation, capability building, or exit based on sustained results.
* Govern partner categories including sales partners, service centres, logistics partners, and contact\-centre partners with tailored KPIs and recovery plans.
* Convert dashboards, reviews, audits, and VOC into corrective and preventive action plans with clear owners, deadlines, and measurable outcomes.
* Track actions centrally, escalate overdue or recurring gaps, and validate effectiveness through operating data and customer outcomes.
* Embed reporting, SOP, system, SLA, and governance requirements during partner onboarding and expansion.
* Identify partner capability and training needs; coordinate targeted interventions and measure post\-training improvement.
* Build and lead the Partner Success Office; align Sales, Service, Logistics, Contact Centre, Quality, Finance, Data, and Technology teams.
* Present consolidated partner performance, risks, and recommendations to the CSOO and leadership team.


**Required Experience \& Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, Analytics or related discipline; MBA preferred. Certifications in Project Management, Lean Six Sigma, Business Analytics, or Power BI are advantageous.
* Experience: 10\-14 years in Partner Success, Partner Operations, Performance Management, Service Operations, Customer Experience, or Business Operations; with 4\+ years in leadership roles.
* Leadership: Experience managing high\-volume, multi\-location, SLA\-driven partner ecosystems and senior partner stakeholders; leading cross\-functional teams and reporting to senior leadership.
* Technical Expertise: Partner governance and relationship management; KPI/SLA design; MIS automation; Advanced Excel; Power BI or Tableau; working knowledge of SQL; performance scorecards; WBR/MBR/QBR management; RCA and CAPA; NPS/CSAT analytics.
* Soft Skills: Strategic, analytical, disciplined in action closure, strong executive communication, negotiation, stakeholder influence, and business/commercial acumen.


 Why Consider this Opportunity?
   

  

* Lead the central governance and performance management function for a large, complex partner ecosystem impacting millions of customers.
* Drive measurable improvements in SLA, TAT, quality, productivity, NPS/CSAT, and partner performance scores.
* Shape and embed data\-driven partner governance frameworks and automated reporting tools with high stakeholder visibility.
* Collaborate across Sales, Service, Logistics, Contact Centre, Quality, Finance, Data, and Technology teams to influence business outcomes.
* Operate at the intersection of customer experience and operational excellence within a fast\-growing technology\-enabled service platform.

title: Client Success & Growth Manager
description:
**⚠️ Please read before applying:** 
 This role pays a maximum of
 **₹8 LPA** 
 . If your expected CTC is above ₹8 LPA, please do not apply — it will not be a fit, and we want to respect everyone's time.
 



  





**Client Success and Growth Manager** 




**Futwork \| Marol, Andheri East, Mumbai (5–6 min walk from the metro)** 




**About Futwork** 




 Futwork runs AI \+ human voice calls for enterprises, handling both inbound and outbound calling. We power 10M\+ conversations a month for top companies like Amazon, Flipkart, Paytm, Lenskart, Shiprocket and BharatPe across logistics, e\-commerce, fintech, education and more.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 You will own a set of B2B client accounts (partners who run their calling operations with us \- Voice AI and Humans). You are responsible for retaining these clients, making sure they hit their goals, and growing each account over time. This is a mix of client ownership, coordination, problem\-solving, and growth.
 



  





**This is not a typical SaaS client success role** 




 If your idea of client success is onboarding, driving adoption, and chasing renewals — this role is different, and probably not for you.
 



  





 At Futwork, you don't just keep the account running.
 **You own how well it performs and how much it grows.** 
 That means:
 


* You are responsible for the client actually hitting their targets and getting real ROI from us — not just being "onboarded."
* You dig into performance data, find why numbers are off, and fix them with our internal teams.
* You drive the growth of the account — more use cases, more volume, more value — not just protect what already exists.
* You work like a mini business owner for your accounts: you understand the client's business, our operations, and the numbers, and you take smart decisions to move things forward.



 This role needs sharp thinking, strong ownership, and comfort with data and problem\-solving. If that excites you, read on.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Own 5–7 client accounts and be their main point of contact at Futwork.
* Understand each client's business, their goals, and the return they expect for the money they spend with us.
* Manage Voice AI agents, suggest improvements, and work with the tech and ops team to improve the call quality and results from the voice AI agent.
* Take client requirements and pass them clearly to our internal teams (operations and tech).
* Make sure new processes go live on time, and keep the client updated at every step.
* Track performance against agreed benchmarks. If numbers are not being met, dig into why.
* Do a proper root cause analysis (RCA) when things go off track, find the real gap, and fix it with the internal team.
* Check that our operations team is running the process correctly, and close any gaps you spot.
* Set the right expectations with clients, so there are no surprises.
* Handle discussions between our tech/ops teams and the client's teams.
* When there are limitations at our end, communicate them honestly and in a way that keeps the client's trust.
* Look for ways to grow the account — more use cases, more volume, more value.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 2–3 years of experience in a relevant role (account management, client relationship management, client success, operations, or similar). Minimum 2 years.
* A track record of owning client relationships and driving results — not just onboarding or support.
* Smart, logical thinkers who can break down a problem and find the real reason behind it.
* Strong common sense and the ability to take good decisions on your own.
* People who can understand both our business and the client's business quickly.
* Good communicators who can keep clients calm, confident and informed.
* Comfortable coordinating across many teams and keeping timelines on track.
* Analytical mindset — you enjoy digging into data and numbers to find answers.



  





**Tools You Should Know** 



* Strong hands\-on skills in Excel and Google Sheets.
* Comfortable with data reporting — building and reading reports to track performance.
* Handy with AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI Studio, and similar.
* Able to use AI tools to automate processes and repetitive tasks wherever possible, to work faster and smarter.



  





**Details** 



* **Experience:** 
 Minimum 2 years in a client\-facing role. Minimum 1 year in a similar/relevant role
* **Salary:** 
 ₹4\.8–8 LPA
* **Location:** 
 Marol, Andheri East, Mumbai — 5–6\-minute walk from the metro station (on\-site).
* **⚠️ One more time:** 
 This role pays
 **₹4\.8–8 LPA** 
 . If your expected CTC is above ₹8 LPA, please do not apply.

The ideal candidate should possess a strong understanding of financial markets, investment products, and SaaS platforms, as well as excellent written communication, analytical thinking, and leadership skills. * Conduct regular audits of customer support emails, tickets, and calls in accordance with the organisation's quality audit framework.
* Review customer interactions to ensure adherence to communication standards, product knowledge requirements, SLA commitments, and customer experience benchmarks.
* Track quality metrics and identify recurring gaps, trends, and opportunities for improvement across the team.
* Provide structured feedback, coaching, and training recommendations based on audit findings.
* Ensure consistent compliance with support processes, quality standards, and customer communication guidelines.
* Partner with relevant stakeholders to implement corrective and preventive actions based on audit observations.



  





**4\. Financial Data \& Investment Product Support:** 




 Assist customers with queries related to:
 


* Equities (Stocks)
* Mutual Funds
* PMS
* AIFs
* Bonds \& Fixed Income Instruments
* ETFs
* Alternative Investments



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Analysing portfolio data, transactions, holdings, and reports to identify root causes of customer issues.
* Assisting customers in understanding platform outputs, reports, performance calculations, and investment\-related data.
* Providing consultative guidance on data interpretation and portfolio reporting.



  





**5\. Customer Success \& Relationship Management:** 



* Deliver a high\-quality customer experience through professional, accurate, and empathetic written communication.
* Build trust and credibility by acting as a knowledgeable advisor to customers.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve customer adoption and platform utilisation.
* Gather and document customer feedback, feature requests, and recurring pain points.
* Ensure consistent communication and follow\-up throughout the customer lifecycle.



  





**6\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 



* Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Operations, Onboarding, and Customer Success teams to resolve customer issues efficiently.
* Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure smooth handling of escalations and customer concerns.
* Communicate customer insights, recurring trends, and improvement opportunities to internal teams.
* Participate in initiatives to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.



  





**7\. Process Improvement \& Operational Excellence:** 



* Take ownership of continuously improving customer support processes, workflows, and operational efficiency.
* Identify process gaps, bottlenecks, recurring customer issues, and inefficiencies across the support function.
* Analyse support metrics, ticket trends, audit findings, customer feedback, and escalation patterns to drive improvements.
* Design and implement scalable solutions that improve response times, resolution quality, customer satisfaction, and team productivity.
* Develop, standardise, and maintain SOPs, workflows, quality guidelines, and best practices across the support team.
* Drive automation and process optimisation initiatives to reduce manual effort and improve operational effectiveness.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Operations, and Customer Success teams to implement long\-term solutions for recurring issues.
* Track the impact of process improvement initiatives and establish measurable outcomes to ensure continuous enhancement of support operations.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and operational excellence within the team.



  





**8\. Knowledge Management \& Documentation:** 



* Create and maintain internal knowledge resources, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and training documentation.
* Ensure knowledge repositories remain up to date with product enhancements, process changes, and resolutions of recurring issues.
* Contribute to onboarding and training initiatives for new team members.
* Promote knowledge sharing and best practices across the Customer Success team.



  





**Desired Candidate** 



* ProfileBachelor's degree in Finance, Commerce, Business, Economics, or a related field.
* 4\-6 years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Support, Client Servicing, Operations, or related roles.
* Prior experience leading or mentoring customer support or customer success teams.
* Strong understanding of financial markets and investment products, including Stocks, Mutual Funds, PMS, AIFs, Bonds, ETFs, and other wealth management products.
* Excellent written communication skills with strong grammar and business email etiquette.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.

* Experience working with SaaS products and technology platforms.

**Key Leadership Traits** 



* Self\-starter who can quickly understand processes and contribute from day one.

* Strong ownership mindset with the capability to independently manage and improve support operations.

title: Client Success and Growth Executive
description:
**We're hiring a Client Success \& Growth Manager.** 




**The bridge between our clients, our creative team, and what we deliver.** 




  





 Krushit Vanzara Studios is a creative post\-production studio specializing in Photo Retouching, Video Editing, Motion Graphics, and Graphic Design, serving clients worldwide. Our editors do the craft. We need someone to ensure projects reach the right clients, on time and exactly as briefed, and to help us find more of them.
 



  





**What you'll do:** 



* **Own client communication:** 
 Be the main point of contact for clients. Take briefs, handle feedback, manage expectations, and maintain strong relationships.
* **Drive project delivery:** 
 Translate client briefs into clear instructions for the team, track timelines, and make sure every deliverable goes out on time and to spec.
* **Coordinate the team:** 
 Work daily with editors and team leads on priorities, workloads, and revisions, and flag issues before they reach the client.
* **Bring in new business:** 
 Research prospects, run outreach over email and LinkedIn, and convert conversations into projects.
* **Run our social presence:** 
 Post creatives and showcase our work across our social channels to support client acquisition.
* **Brainstorm everything:** 
 Contribute ideas across client pitches, campaigns, content, and how we work.



  





**You're a fit if you:** 



* Have 2 to 4 years in account management, client servicing, or business development, ideally at a creative agency, studio, or production house
* Write and speak excellent English, since you'll be dealing with international clients daily
* Understand creative work well enough to brief an editor and push back on an unrealistic deadline
* Are organized enough to juggle multiple clients and deliverables without dropping any
* Are comfortable with outreach. A cold email doesn't scare you.
* Know your way around Instagram and LinkedIn
* Bonus: familiarity with project management tools like Asana, Trello, or ClickUp



  





**The good stuff:** 



* Work with international clients across e\-commerce, portraits, real estate, and video
* A real voice in how we grow. Your ideas get acted on.
* Performance bonus
* 20 paid days off: 10 PTO/casual/sick \+ 10 festival and government holidays
* Travel reimbursement
* We have two shifts: 8 am to 5 pm or 11 am to 8 pm; alternate Saturdays are operational.



  





**CTC:** 
 ₹3 to 6 LPA
 



 📍 Mumbai, Work From Office (Mandatory)
 



 📩 Send your CV and a short note on a client you've managed well to hr@krushitvanzara.com

title: National Head – Member Relations
description:
**About the Organization** 




 RAI is a Section 8 not\-for\-profit organization established by retailers to represent and strengthen the interests of modern retail in India. The National Head – Member Relations will serve as the senior leader responsible for deepening member engagement, strengthening institutional relationships, and advancing membership growth across the country.
 



**Role Mandate** 




 This role is designed for a seasoned relationship leader who can engage credibly with senior industry stakeholders, build long\-term strategic partnerships, and translate member needs into high\-value engagement for the association. The mandate combines membership retention, new member acquisition, national team leadership, and cross\-functional coordination to ensure members experience consistent value from RAI’s initiatives.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead the national member relations agenda and act as the primary relationship owner for RAI’s member community across India.
* Build and nurture trusted relationships with senior leaders and key decision\-makers within member organizations.
* Drive membership retention and growth through well\-defined engagement strategies, targeted outreach, and value\-led relationship management.
* Identify and pursue prospective members across existing markets while expanding into new sectors and geographies with relevant potential.
* Lead, coach, and performance\-manage a geographically distributed team against clearly defined goals and membership targets.
* Track performance metrics, review outcomes regularly, and recommend strategic or operational improvements where required.
* Partner closely with Marketing, Retail Learning, and Advocacy teams to ensure that member\-facing initiatives are communicated effectively and delivered in a coordinated manner.
* Foster a collaborative environment with senior industry stakeholders to support participation, alignment, and long\-term association value creation.



**Candidate Profile** 




 The ideal candidate will bring strong commercial judgment, executive presence, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders while leading high\-performing teams in a dynamic, member\-centric environment. The role requires a balance of strategic thinking, operational discipline, and strong interpersonal credibility.
 



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Proven leadership experience in national sales, business development, key account management, member relations, or a comparable senior\-facing role.
* Demonstrated success in managing and motivating high\-performance teams across multiple locations.
* Strong working knowledge of CRM platforms and Microsoft Office tools.
* Ability to interpret performance data and convert insights into actionable plans.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills.
* Strong problem\-solving orientation with a service\-led and relationship\-driven mindset.
* Willingness to travel extensively, as required by the role.
* MBA in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related discipline preferred.



**Compensation** 




 Compensation will be aligned with the candidate’s experience, capabilities, and overall fit for the role.

 Function: Investor Relations \| Retention \| Business Development
   

  

**About The Role**
 Arbour Alternate Advisors Private Limited is a Mumbai\-based investment management firm focused on structured real estate credit and high\-yield debt strategies within the alternative investments space.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Manager – Strategic Investor Relations to manage and strengthen direct investor relationships across HNIs, UHNIs, Single and Multi\-Family Offices, corporate/institutional investors, and sophisticated investors.
   

  

 The role will be responsible for investor relationship management, communication, servicing, retention, re\-investment opportunities, and strategic investor engagement.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Manage relationships with HNI, UHNI and Family Office investors across the complete post\-commitment lifecycle.
* Build strong relationships with investor principals, Family Office investment committees and trusted advisors.
* Coordinate with Operations, Compliance and Investment teams to ensure a high\-quality investor experience.
* Maintain comprehensive investor records, interaction history and relationship intelligence.
* Manage investor communications including performance reports, NAV updates, capital call notices, distribution statements and regulatory disclosures.
* Prepare investor communication calendars, quarterly reports, market updates and investor briefings.
* Develop personalised performance summaries, portfolio commentary and re\-investment proposals.
* Conduct investor meetings, portfolio reviews, AGMs and bespoke investor briefings.
* Act as the first point of contact for investor queries, documentation and escalations.
* Coordinate KYC updates, subscription processing, regulatory filings, capital calls, distributions and investor statement reconciliation.
* Develop investor retention strategies and identify re\-investment, incremental capital and referral opportunities.
* Maintain a structured re\-investment pipeline covering maturity dates, investor conversations and capital opportunities.
* Track investor feedback and satisfaction to improve engagement and communication quality.
* Monitor alternative investment trends, regulatory developments and HNI/UHNI/Family Office preferences.
* Provide investor sentiment and market intelligence to the Investment and Product teams.
* Represent the company at investor forums, Family Office summits and networking events.
* Contribute to the overall investor relations and retention strategy.


 Candidate Profile
   

  

* Postgraduate qualification in Finance, MBA, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* CFA, CFP or relevant investment certification will be an advantage.
* 8–10 years of experience in Investor Relations, Private Banking, Wealth Management or Alternative Investment Servicing.
* Proven experience managing and retaining HNI, UHNI and Family Office relationships.
* Experience in direct Investor Relations within an AIF, PMS, Private Equity, Real Estate Fund or alternative investment platform is preferred.
* Strong understanding of alternative investment products, structured credit, capital calls, distributions and AIF investor regulations in India.
* Established network within the HNI, UHNI and Family Office investor community in Mumbai.


 Key Skills
   

  

* Direct Investor Relationship Management
* HNI / UHNI / Family Office Servicing
* Investor Communication \& Reporting
* Investor Retention \& Re\-investment
* AIF / PMS Knowledge
* Alternative Investment Products
* Capital Call \& Distribution Management
* Investor Query \& Escalation Management

* Recommend changes in products, services and policies by evaluating results and competitive developments

 we provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work\-from home, hybrid, or work\-from\-the\-office environment.

 We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20 \+ affinity groups where you can network and connect with Newfolders globally.

 At Newfold, taking care of our employees is our top priority. we make sure that cutting edge benefits are in place to for you. Some of the benefits you will have: We have partnered with some of the best insurance providers to provide you excellent Health Insurance options, Education/ Certification Sponsorships to give you a chance to further your knowledge, Flexi\-leaves to take personal time off and much more. Building a community one domain at a time, one employee at a time. All our employees are eligible for a free domain and WordPress blog as we sponsor the domain registration costs.

description:
**Role Summary** 




 The core responsibilities of Key Account Manager for Strategic Account at Perfios can be broken down into key areas: Account Management, Sales Strategy Development, Adoption \& Account Ecosystem, Customer Relationship Management, Problem Management and Revenue Growth.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 



* **Account Development**



 Manage One Large Account for Perfios with Strong business development, pipeline build \& management, Relationship building \& development, Escalation Management, Internal collaboration \& Stakeholder management skills.
 


* **Sales Strategy Development**



 The Key Account Manager is responsible for developing a comprehensive sales strategy that aligns with the company's overall goals and objectives for a large account. This involves building a strong account plan for the Strategic Account, defining sales pipeline build plan, Planning to achieve sales targets, Collections and developing pricing propositions that are competitive and sustainable.
 



 Additionally, the Account Manager must track account trends, competition, and customer needs to adjust the sales strategy as needed to maximize revenue growth, come up with innovative contracting models for large clients. Plan engagements without RFPs and work on nomination basis with the client by showcasing Perfios value proposition.
 


* **Adoption \& Building a strong account ecosystem**



 The Strategic Key Account Manager is responsible for building a strong account system through a team of Sales, Solutioning, Customer Success, Product professionals or a strategic account to achieve sales targets, stronger adoption of Perfios Tech and drive revenue growth. This involves deep collaboration skills across teams, clear roles \& responsibilities, managing extended teams and building a strong ecosystem of professionals managing the client for higher revenue performance, best account management \& good P\&L through collections.
 


* **Customer Relationship Management**



 The Strategic Key Account Manager is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with clients through effective communication, customer support, and proactive engagement. This involves understanding the needs of the customer, providing solutions that meet those needs, and staying ahead of any potential issues or concerns. Should be proficient with Perfios pitch \& value proposition for all the stakeholders across the client relationships. Should have the vision to get the Perfios pitch implemented through the teams as well as tailor make the pitch based on clients vision \& strategy.
 


* **Revenue Growth**



 The Strategic Key Account Manager must be focused on revenue growth, which involves increasing sales volume, Month on Month revenue growth, New Engagements going live, improving pricing strategies, and identifying and capitalizing on new sales opportunities. This requires a deep understanding of the company's sales metrics, including better adoption, Cross Sell/Upsell, average deal size, and sales cycles, which can be used to measure and track performance over time.
 



**Required experience:** 




 ● Bachelor’s degree in Business/ Master’s degree will be plus but not mandatory.
 



 ● Minimum 7\-8 years of experience in Key account management primarily from Technology/ PSU background with specific experience in banking.
 



 ● Good understanding in technology
 



 ● Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong
 



 ● relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.
 



 ● Strong analytical skills and experience with customer success tools and metrics.
 



 ● Passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences and driving customer satisfaction

title: Customer Success Representative
description:
Job Title: Account Manager / Customer Success Representative
 



 Location: Goregaon West, Mumbai (Full\-Time, On\-Site)
 



  





 About Mudita
 



 Mudita is a leading edtech organization committed to transforming learning experiences through innovative educational programs. Our mission is to empower learners with the knowledge, skills, and guidance they need to achieve meaningful growth and success. We take pride in delivering exceptional learner experiences and fostering long\-term client relationships.
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We are seeking a proactive and customer\-focused Account Manager / Customer Success Representative to ensure the successful onboarding, engagement, and overall satisfaction of our clients. In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for learners, guiding them throughout their educational journey, addressing concerns, and helping them achieve their desired outcomes.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Conduct onboarding sessions to familiarize clients with their enrolled programs and learning journey.
* Provide comprehensive guidance on course structure, milestones, expectations, and success parameters.
* Monitor learner progress regularly to ensure active participation, assignment completion, and session attendance.
* Act as the main point of contact for client support, addressing queries and resolving concerns in a timely manner.
* Build strong client relationships to enhance satisfaction, retention, and overall program success.
* Collaborate with internal teams to improve learner engagement and drive successful outcomes.



 Qualifications
 


* 2–4 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related client\-facing role.
* Prior experience in the online education, coaching, or edtech industry will be an added advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships and resolve issues effectively.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills with a customer\-centric approach.
* Passionate about delivering exceptional client experiences and achieving measurable results.
* Must own a laptop and be willing to work from our Goregaon West office.



 What You'll Get
 


* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Direct mentorship and guidance from experienced industry professionals.
* Exposure to innovative learning solutions and a fast\-growing edtech environment.
* The chance to make a meaningful impact on learner success and organizational growth.

**About Grexa** 




 Grexa AI is a venture\-backed startup on a mission to build the world's first Marketing AI Platform for small businesses, a fully autonomous system that drives Real Revenue by automating and optimizing digital marketing.
 



  





 Founded by 4 seasoned IIT alumni and former Testbook Founders / CXOs (who scaled Testbook into a $30Mn ARR business with 1,000\+ employees, later successfully acquired by a leading edtech company), the team brings deep product expertise, execution speed, and a proven track record of building at scale.
 



  





 We're funded, building fast, and assembling a high\-performing team to disrupt the global digital marketing space from India. If you're excited to solve real problems and build transformative AI products — this is your calling.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We're looking for a Growth Manager to act as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for our clients and own their business growth end\-to\-end. This is a client\-facing role that sits at the intersection of growth, customer success, and revenue expansion.
 



  





 You'll work closely with a large portfolio of SMB clients — high in volume, though individually low in ticket size — to ensure they adopt Grexa deeply, see real business outcomes, and continue growing with us through renewals, upsells and cross\-sells. This role is ideal for someone with a SaaS/SMB account management or sales background who thrives on managing scale: many accounts, fast cycles, and consistent execution.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Act as the primary SPOC for a high\-volume portfolio of SMB clients, building strong, trust\-based relationships at scale.
* Create and implement structured onboarding processes to deeply understand each client's business and ensure Grexa is integrated into their daily operations.
* Monitor client engagement and usage metrics to proactively identify adoption gaps, risks, and growth opportunities across a large book of accounts.
* Drive retention, renewals, upsells, and cross\-sells by aligning Grexa's features with evolving client needs.
* Advise clients on how to unlock more value from the platform through advanced features and tailored strategies.
* Act as the strategic bridge between clients and internal teams (Product, Growth, Ops) to ensure smooth issue resolution and continuous improvement.
* Champion the voice of the client by collecting detailed feedback and translating it into actionable insights for product and service innovation.

Hand over customer requests to DATE or Operations Centres in case the requests fall into the service scope of those units.

title: Portfolio Manager
description:
Account Management, Client Relations, Client Retention, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Real Estate
   

  

 Portfolio Manager
   

  

**C$30,000–C$36,000 Annually \| Full\-Time \| Remote \| Eastern Time Hours**
 The Opportunity
   

  

 Royal York Property Management is hiring a Portfolio Manager to manage a portfolio of existing clients, properties, and active service files.
   

  

 You will keep clients informed, monitor rent and account activity, coordinate property services, resolve problems, renew agreements, and protect client relationships.
   

  

 This role requires strong service ownership and sales ability. You must be comfortable handling objections, explaining value, discussing pricing, preventing cancellations, and identifying opportunities to expand client relationships.
   

  

 Direct property\-management experience is preferred but not required. Candidates with strong experience in account management, portfolio management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
* Act as the primary contact for an assigned portfolio of property owners and tenants.
* Manage multiple client accounts, properties, and active service files.
* Complete client onboarding and collect required property, owner, and tenant documents.
* Provide proactive updates about completed work, outstanding issues, and next steps.
* Monitor rent collection and follow up on overdue balances.
* Review monthly property activity before owner payouts, including rent received, fees, expenses, invoices, reserves, and holdbacks.
* Investigate account discrepancies and coordinate corrections with the accounting team.
* Coordinate maintenance requests with internal teams and external service providers.
* Handle owner and tenant complaints, urgent issues, and service escalations.
* Identify dissatisfied or at\-risk clients and take action to prevent avoidable cancellations.
* Manage agreement renewals and discuss pricing or service concerns within company guidelines.
* Handle objections, reinforce the value of the company’s services, and identify appropriate opportunities to expand client relationships.
* Monitor tenant notices, vacancies, turnovers, and re\-leasing activity.
* Maintain accurate CRM notes, documents, tasks, deadlines, and follow\-ups.
* Identify stalled files and escalate financial, legal, or service risks when necessary.
* Use technology and AI tools to improve documentation, communication, reporting, and efficiency.


**What You’ll Need**
* Three or more years of experience in account management, portfolio management, property management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations.
* Experience managing multiple clients, accounts, properties, claims, cases, or active files simultaneously.
* Experience with client retention, renewals, objection handling, negotiation, account growth, or consultative sales.
* Experience monitoring rent, invoices, recurring payments, accounts receivable, or overdue balances.
* Confidence reviewing account activity, statements, expenses, and supporting documents.
* Strong client communication and experience handling complaints or escalations.
* Excellent organization, documentation, and follow\-through.
* Experience using a CRM, ticketing system, property\-management platform, or workflow\-management system.
* Ability to coordinate work across internal departments and external providers.
* Strong judgment when managing deadlines, financial concerns, sensitive information, and client expectations.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Availability to work full\-time during Eastern Time business hours.
* Reliable internet, backup connectivity or power, a suitable computer, and a professional environment for calls.


 Experience in property management, leasing, real estate operations, housing, facilities, insurance, financial services, SaaS, telecommunications, managed services, or another recurring\-service industry will be considered.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Success means maintaining an organized portfolio, communicating proactively, collecting rent promptly, reviewing property accounts accurately, resolving service issues, securing renewals, protecting client relationships, and supporting portfolio growth.
   

  

 Who Will Succeed
   

  

 The right person takes ownership instead of waiting to be reminded. You are comfortable handling difficult conversations, challenging unclear explanations, negotiating professionally, and coordinating several parties until a problem is fully resolved.
   

  

 You are client\-focused and commercially aware. You know how to protect a relationship without making promises, offering discounts, or bypassing procedures simply to satisfy a client.
   

  

**Compensation**
 The annual compensation range is
 **C$30,000–C$36,000** 
 , based on relevant experience, qualifications, and demonstrated ability.
   

  

 How to Apply
   

  

 Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you will receive an email with a link to complete a short pre\-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.

title: Account Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
   

  

 Account Manager – Marketing Clients
   

  

 Company: BingeAt Media LLP
   

 Department: Client Servicing / Marketing
   

 Location: Kalyan / Mumbai
   

 Employment Type: Full\-Time
   

 Experience: Minimum 3years in Account Management, Client Servicing, Digital Marketing or Agency Operations
   

  

 About the Role
   

  

 BingeAt Media LLP is looking for an Account Manager to manage day\-to\-day relationships with marketing clients and coordinate the successful execution of their marketing requirements.
   

  

 The Account Manager will be responsible for understanding client requirements, planning deliverables, coordinating with internal teams, maintaining communication, monitoring project progress, and ensuring client satisfaction and retention.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 1\. Client Management
   

  

 \- Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.
   

 \- Understand client business objectives, requirements and expectations.
   

 \- Maintain regular communication through calls, meetings, email and approved communication channels.
   

 \- Build strong, professional and long\-term client relationships.
   

 \- Handle client feedback, concerns and escalations professionally.
   

  

 2\. Marketing Project Coordination
   

  

 \- Coordinate with Social Media, Performance Marketing, Creative, Content, Video and Web teams.
   

 \- Prepare and communicate briefs clearly to internal teams.
   

 \- Track project timelines, deliverables and approvals.
   

 \- Ensure deliverables are completed as per agreed scope and timelines.
   

 \- Follow up internally to avoid delays and bottlenecks.
   

  

 3\. Strategy \& Client Understanding
   

  

 \- Understand the client's business, target audience, competitors and marketing objectives.
   

 \- Participate in marketing planning and review meetings.
   

 \- Assist the team in developing monthly marketing plans, campaigns and content strategies.
   

 \- Identify opportunities to improve campaign and marketing performance.
   

  

 4\. Reporting \& Reviews
   

  

 \- Coordinate monthly/periodic performance reports.
   

 \- Present campaign updates and key performance metrics to clients.
   

 \- Maintain records of client feedback, approvals, pending items and action points.
   

 \- Conduct regular account reviews with clients where required.
   

  

 5\. Client Retention \& Growth
   

  

 \- Monitor client satisfaction and identify potential retention risks.
   

 \- Identify opportunities for additional services based on client requirements.
   

 \- Coordinate cross\-selling/up\-selling of relevant services such as:
   

 \- Social Media Management
   

 \- Performance Marketing
   

 \- Branding \& Creative
   

 \- Website Development
   

 \- Video Production
   

 \- SEO
   

 \- Lead Generation
   

 \- Content Marketing
   

 \- Coordinate internally for proposals and quotations for additional requirements.
   

  

 6\. Account Administration
   

  

 \- Maintain updated client information, requirements, deliverables and communication records in the company's systems.
   

 \- Ensure proper documentation of approvals and important decisions.
   

 \- Follow BingeAt Media LLP's internal project management and documentation processes.
   

  

 Required Skills
   

  

 \- Excellent verbal and written communication.
   

 \- Strong client\-handling and relationship\-management skills.
   

 \- Good understanding of digital marketing and social media.
   

 \- Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.
   

 \- Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines.
   

 \- Problem\-solving and escalation\-management ability.
   

 \- Good presentation and meeting skills.
   

 \- Ability to understand business requirements and convert them into actionable briefs.
   

 \- Working knowledge of Google Workspace and project\-management tools.
   

 \- Basic understanding of marketing metrics and campaign performance.
   

  

 Preferred Qualifications
   

  

 \- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Mass Communication or a related field.
   

 \- Prior experience in a digital marketing / advertising / creative agency.
   

 \- Experience handling multiple marketing accounts will be preferred.
   

  

 Performance Expectations
   

  

 The Account Manager will be expected to maintain:
   

  

 \- High client satisfaction and retention.
   

 \- Timely completion of client deliverables.
   

 \- Clear and proactive client communication.
   

 \- Accurate internal coordination and follow\-ups.
   

 \- Strong understanding of assigned client accounts.
   

 \- Identification of opportunities for account growth.
   

 \- Proper documentation and project tracking.
   

  

 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

 \- Client Retention
   

 \- Client Satisfaction
   

 \- Timely Delivery of Projects
   

 \- Client Communication \& Response Management
   

 \- Account Growth / Cross\-Selling
   

 \- Quality of Briefs \& Internal Coordination
   

 \- Reduction in Client Escalations
   

 \- Timely Collection/Follow\-up coordination where assigned
   

  

 Reporting
   

  

 Reports To: General Manager / Business Head / Assigned Team Leader
   

  

 Works Closely With:
   

 Creative Team • Social Media Team • Performance Marketing Team • Content Team • Video Team • Web Development Team • Management
   

  

 Candidate Profile
   

  

 We are looking for someone who is proactive, organised, client\-focused and commercially aware, with the ability to manage relationships while ensuring that the internal team delivers work efficiently.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should not merely take instructions from clients—they should understand the client's business, anticipate requirements, coordinate solutions and contribute to the growth of the account.

**About Us** 





 Qure.ai
 
 is a global healthtech company using artificial intelligence to improve disease detection and patient outcomes at scale. Our solutions are deployed across hospitals, diagnostic networks, and public health programs worldwide.
 



 Today, our technology has impacted
 **40M\+ lives** 
 across
 **105\+ countries** 
 , deployed across
 **5,200\+ sites** 
 , and powered by one of the world’s largest real\-world medical imaging datasets. With
 **26 FDA\-cleared indications** 
 , we are helping shape the future of AI\-driven healthcare.
 



  





  





**The Opportunity** 




 Qure.ai’s AI solutions are already embedded in the workflows of leading pharmaceutical companies such as AstraZeneca, Merck, Lilly and J\&J. As pharma continues to be our fastest\-growing business in the US, this is a field\-facing, high\-ownership role at the forefront of driving our next phase of growth.
 



  





 You’ll report to the Senior Director, Life Sciences Partnerships, who leads partnership strategy and deal development, and work closely with our Strategy and Growth Team, who support account planning, commercial collateral, and deal execution. You'll also collaborate with the SVP, Life Sciences Partnerships, who leads the business globally. In this role, you'll own the field\-building pipeline, developing strategic customer relationships, and driving opportunities from initial engagement through to successful closure.
 



 This role is designed as a high\-growth commercial path, with opportunities to take ownership of strategic accounts and grow into senior partnerships as the business scales.
 



  





 If you’re 3–5 years into a career in healthcare consulting, life sciences, digital health, or a client\-facing commercial role, and are eager to build strategic relationships, create new business opportunities, and thrive in a fast\-paced, field\-facing environment, this role is built for you.
 



  





  





**What You’ll Own \& Drive** 



* Build and manage a pipeline of pharma partnership opportunities across oncology, cardiology, respiratory and other priority therapeutic areas.
* Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders – including Medical Affairs, Market Access, Digital Health and Commercial leads \- within strategic accounts including AstraZeneca, Merck, Lilly and J\&J, while expanding into new pharma logos.
* Represent Qure.ai at industry conferences, customer meetings and life sciences events across the US \- identifying new opportunities and converting engagements into qualified pipeline.
* Partner with the Senior Director, Life Sciences Partnerships to shape partnership strategies and commercial opportunities by translating Qure.ai's clinical and AI capabilities into compelling value propositions.
* Collaborate closely with the Strategy and Growth team to develop account plans, proposals, presentations, and commercial collateral that support successful customer engagements.
* Own the day\-to\-day commercial execution, including prospecting, outreach, meeting cadence, CRM management, follow\-ups, forecasting, and pipeline reporting.
* Develop a strong understanding of priority disease areas, clinical workflows, and Qure.ai's AI solutions to engage credibly with physicians, scientists, and pharmaceutical stakeholders.
* Drive opportunities from initial engagement through contract execution, partnering with the Senior Director on commercial structuring, negotiations, and final approvals.








  





  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 Within your first 6–12 months, you will have:
 


* Built and actively managed a qualified pipeline of strategic pharmaceutical partnership opportunities, with accurate forecasting and CRM reporting.

 Track record of expanding a shrinking spend into a growing spend within the same account

title: Solutions Architect - India
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
   

  

****About The Role****
 We’re hiring Solution Architects to help the world’s best engineering organizations figure out what AI\-native software development actually looks like in production.
   

  

 This is a deeply technical, post\-sale role embedded inside SpaceXAI’s most strategic enterprise accounts. You’ll work directly with engineering teams to roll out high\-impact workflows, accelerate adoption, and help organizations fundamentally rethink how software gets built with AI.
   

  

 Solution Architects sit at the center of long\-term customer transformation. You’ll help customers move from initial excitement to deeply integrating engineering workflows that teams rely on every day. That means understanding how modern software organizations operate, identifying where Cursor can create the most leverage, and helping customers scale adoption across teams, platforms, and workflows over time.
   

  

 This role is highly hands\-on. You’ll configure environments, design workflows, run enablement sessions, and solve technical problems directly with developers and platform teams inside complex enterprise environments. You’ll also help engineering leaders think through rollout strategy, workflow evolution, and the long\-term architecture for AI\-native development.
   

  

 The best Solution Architects combine deep technical credibility with strong product instincts, high ownership, and the ability to influence how large engineering organizations evolve. Solution Architects are also equally comfortable debugging CI workflows, leading architecture reviews, and helping executives understand where AI changes the economics of software development.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
**Help Engineering Teams Adopt AI\-Native Development**
* Roll out Cursor across strategic engineering organizations
* Configure environments, design workflows, and run hands\-on enablement sessions
* Help developers integrate Cursor into real production workflows, not isolated demos
* Drive fast time\-to\-value and durable adoption across teams
* Identify workflow friction and solve problems quickly


**Expand Cursor Across the Organization**
* Identify where Cursor should expand next inside the customer environment
* Help engineering organizations evolve from isolated usage to company\-wide adoption
* Design rollout strategies for new workflows, teams, and platform groups
* Partner with customers to operationalize AI\-assisted development at scale
* Work closely with Account Executives during major expansion moments


**Become a Trusted Technical Partner**
* Build deep relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering leadership, and executive stakeholders
* Lead architecture reviews, technical working sessions, and strategic planning discussions
* Advise customers on developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and AI adoption strategy
* Coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to unblock customer progress
* Help organizations navigate workflow and operational change as AI\-native development evolves


**Drive Real Customer Outcomes**
* Help customers translate adoption into measurable engineering impact
* Connect Cursor usage to outcomes like faster iteration cycles, improved developer productivity, workflow efficiency, and engineering quality
* Help customers communicate the value of Cursor internally and build momentum for broader adoption
* Turn successful deployments into repeatable workflow patterns across the organization


**Help Make Cursor Indispensable**
* Deepen workflow adoption and long\-term product stickiness
* Monitor competitive risk and help customers standardize on Cursor over time
* Support recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction
* Help customers build workflows they can’t imagine operating without


**Shape the Future of the Product**
* Bring structured feedback from strategic customers into Product and Engineering
* Identify emerging workflow patterns, friction points, and enterprise requirements
* Help shape new capabilities through lighthouse customers and design partnerships
* Turn successful customer workflows into reusable playbooks and reference patterns


**You may be a fit if**
* You have a strong technical background in software engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, or developer tooling
* You have experience in customer\-facing technical roles such as Solution Architect, Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Architect, or similar
* You have the ability to work hands\-on with engineering teams while also operating strategically with technical leadership
* You have a strong understanding of developer workflows, SDLC tooling, integrations, CI/CD systems, governance, and enterprise engineering environments
* You have excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly across both technical and executive audiences
* You have strong instincts around workflow design, adoption strategy, and driving workflow change across engineering teams
* You have high ownership, strong execution skills, and comfort operating in fast\-moving environments with ambiguity
* You have a passion for developer tooling and strong conviction around how AI will reshape software engineering
* You are willing to travel to customers needed
