title: Sr. CSM (Logistics Tech)
description:
Portcast is a venture\-backed, Singapore\-based logistics technology company building AI\-powered intelligence for the freight forwarding industry. Freight forwarders manage thousands of shipments, rates, exceptions, and operational decisions every day. The challenge is not a lack of data. It is knowing what needs attention, what is going wrong, and what action to take next.
   

  

 Portcast uses AI and data to help freight forwarders surface shipment exceptions, identify cost and margin risks, and make better decisions across the shipment lifecycle. Our products help teams improve operational efficiency, protect margins, and make faster, more informed decisions. Our vision is to become the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.
   

  

 Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are a lean, globally distributed team building technology for an industry going through a major digital transformation.
   

  

****ABOUT THE ROLE:****
 We're looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to own our enterprise customer relationships end to end. Our CS team owns the full commercial relationship, strategic account management, adoption, renewal, expansion, and customer support, working directly with enterprise customers and their C\-suite. This is a senior individual\-contributor (IC) role for someone who can build trust and credibility at that level.
   

  

 At the heart of the role is discovery. The best expansion comes from deeply understanding what each customer is really trying to achieve, where their pain sits, and how Portcast turns their data into decisions and measurable business impact. Strong discovery is what lets you deepen adoption, grow your accounts, and drive real revenue from your existing customers, through upsell, cross\-sell, and new teams and regions.
   

  

 You'll also be technically fluent enough to be the customer's first point of contact on their questions and tickets, triaging the issue, working with our Data team to get the answer, and communicating a clear resolution back to the customer, all alongside the strategic work: QBRs, success plans, renewals, and expansion.
   

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:**
* Enterprise customers deeply adopt Portcast with measurable business outcomes, and see you as a trusted advisor at both the operational and C\-suite level.
* Discovery that consistently surfaces real customer needs and turns them into adoption, retention, and expansion.
* A steady expansion pipeline from existing accounts (upsell, cross\-sell, new teams and regions), with CS trusted, internally and by customers, to identify and drive those deals.
* Fast, credible resolution of customer questions and tickets, in partnership with the Data team, so customers always get reliable answers and stay confident in Portcast.


**WHAT YOU’LL OWN:**
* Own the full enterprise customer lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, renewal, and retention, ensuring a smooth, high\-impact experience.
* Lead discovery: deeply understand each customer's goals, workflows, pain points, and internal decision processes, so you can grow the account and drive expansion.
* Be a trusted advisor to enterprise stakeholders, including C\-suite, aligning Portcast to their strategic goals and addressing their challenges.
* Identify and drive expansion (upsell, cross\-sell, new teams, new regions) in partnership with Sales, positioning CS as a credible driver of new revenue from existing customers.
* Own customer questions and tickets: triage the issue, work with the Data team to get the answer, then review and communicate a clear resolution back to the customer.
* Run QBRs, success plans, and regular check\-ins, using data, outcomes, and clear narratives to drive adoption and expansion.
* Partner with Product, Data, and Engineering to channel customer feedback and influence the roadmap.
* Analyze customer usage and data to surface actionable insights and continuously improve the customer journey.


**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
* Bachelor's or Master's in Business, Logistics, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent.
* 7\+ years in a commercial, customer\-facing role, Customer Success, Account Management, Pre\-sales/Solutions, or Sales, within the logistics industry or logistics technology space.
* A pre\-sales or solutions background is highly valued. Strong discovery is one of the most important skills in this role, it's what lets you expand existing customers and drive new revenue.
* Logistics / logistics\-tech domain: familiarity with freight forwarding and global logistics workflows, and the ability to confidently engage customers across operations and commercial stakeholders.
* Comfortable with enterprise customers and their C\-suite, with strong stakeholder management across functions and seniority levels.
* Technical fluency: comfortable with basic data, APIs, and SaaS concepts, enough to handle customer questions and tickets, work with our Data team, and translate technical answers into clear customer\-facing resolutions.
* A track record of driving account expansion (upsell, cross\-sell) and revenue growth from existing customers.
* Experience running QBRs and structured account success plans, using data and outcomes to drive adoption and expansion.
* Excellent, structured communication, especially with complex, multi\-stakeholder enterprise customers.
* High ownership and independence, with the ability to operate in a lean startup environment and a bias for action.


**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**
* Work at the intersection of AI, data, and logistics: help enterprise customers turn predictive data into decisions and measurable business impact.
* Real impact from day one: we're lean by design, with few layers between you and the outcome, so your work moves adoption, retention, and expansion directly.
* Globally distributed, remote\-first flexibility: work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.


**OUR CORE VALUES GUIDE EVERYTHING WE DO:**
* Curiosity: This is where discovery lives. We dig beneath what a customer asks for to what they're actually trying to achieve, staying genuinely curious about their business, their workflows, and how a freight forwarder really operates. That depth is where every expansion starts.
* Ownership: We act like founders. We own the customer relationship and the commercial outcome end to end, adoption, renewal, and expansion, and we stay on an account until the value is real and the number moves.
* Raising the bar: We don't settle for a renewed contract. We aim for customers who adopt deeply, expand with us, and become advocates, and we hold ourselves to that standard on every account.
* Effectiveness: We focus on the outcomes that matter, real adoption, retention, and revenue growth from our customers, not check\-ins or activity for their own sake. We prioritize the accounts and conversations that actually move the business.


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets.**

**At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. **Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!**
**Your Role: Territory Sales Manager \- Dairy**
 As a Territory Sales Manager, you will be responsible for driving sales growth and strengthening Elanco’s presence in the assigned region by engaging with veterinary professionals, farm owners, and distributors. Your role will focus on building strong customer relationships, executing company strategies, and ensuring timely product movement and payment collection.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities:**
* Meet with veterinarians and other key customers to promote animal health products and generate profitable sales.
* Collaborate with distributors to drive product liquidation and encourage repeat purchasing.
* Follow up on outstanding payments from customers and distributors to ensure timely collections.
* Implement company strategies in the field, monitor competitor activity, and provide timely feedback.
* Achieve sales targets and maintain accurate records of customer and territory data.


**What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Veterinary Science, Animal Husbandry, Agriculture, or a related field.
* Experience: Prior experience in animal health or pharmaceutical sales, preferably in a territory\-based role.
* Top Skills: Strong communication, relationship management, and sales execution skills.


**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (preferred qualifications):**
* Strong understanding of the animal health market, including veterinary channels and livestock farming.
* Experience working with distributors and managing accounts receivable.
* Proven ability to meet sales targets and execute field strategies effectively.
* High levels of ethics, self\-discipline, and accountability.
* Proficiency in reporting systems and Microsoft Office tools.


**Additional Information:**
* Location: Based in India – field\-based role covering an assigned sales territory.
* Travel: Frequent travel required within the assigned region for customer engagement and distributor meetings.
* Must attend company meetings and training sessions as scheduled and comply with all company policies and reporting systems.

title: Senior Brand Partnerships Manager
description:
We’re looking for someone who can make brands want to be part of the experience.
 



  





 The Winter Flea, India's Biggest Holiday Festival, is back, and we’re building bigger, bolder and more memorable brand experiences around it.
 



  





**Please note:** 
 This is a hybrid role and requires frequent travel to Jaipur during the planning and execution period. Candidates should be comfortable with regular travel to Jaipur before applying.

 Most importantly, someone who wants to be part of building a cultural property, not just managing one.
 



  




* If you know how to bring the right brands into the right moments, we’d love to hear from you.

**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector
   

  

 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50\+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
   

  

 Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re\-designing software development processes to become AI\-native end\-to\-end (“AI\-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship\-building skills, intrinsic problem\-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands\-on transformation leadership.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP\+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade\-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time\-to\-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive\-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed\-price, milestone\-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI\-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI\-DLC (AI\-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes\-based governance frameworks for AI\-native builds, and steering multi\-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI\-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

 Diverse Experiences

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. title: Manager, Travel Experience (Mumbai - Remote)
description:
As a Manager, Travel Experience Consultant, you will lead a dedicated team of Travel Consultants. This role requires a unique blend of people leadership, operational management, and relationship cultivation. You will be responsible for the day\-to\-day oversight of your team, ensuring they provide exceptional service, while also managing the strategic service relationship with the dedicated customer's Travel Manager and Specialists.
   

  

 Your leadership will be key to developing a high\-performing team, driving continuous improvement, and ensuring the success of the offline travel program for our most valued customers.
   

  

 This is a Remote Opportunity within Mumbai, requires candidate to be based in Mumbai.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* People Leadership \& Development: Serve as the frontline manager for a team of Business Travel Consultants. You will be responsible for coaching, training, and upskilling team members to deliver a best\-in\-class customer experience.
* Performance Management: Conduct regular 1:1 meetings and quarterly reviews to monitor progress, set clear expectations, and track career development using career maps. Provide continuous performance feedback to encourage desired behaviors and ensure alignment with corporate goals.
* Operational Management: Oversee the team's operational performance, monitoring call queues (ACD) and SLAs to ensure goals are met. You will perform root cause analysis on common service issues to develop and implement permanent corrective actions and process improvements.
* Customer Relationship Management: Act as the primary point of contact for the dedicated customer's Travel Manager. You will conduct regular check\-ins, present performance statistics, and collaborate on improvement plans and service enhancements.
* Issue \& Escalation Resolution:Take ownership of customer escalations, managing and resolving issues from start to finish. You will coach your team to proactively address traveler inquiries and aim for first\-contact resolution. As Manager, you may also need to step in and directly handle escalated chats and calls to ensure prompt and effective resolution.
* Collaboration \& Communication: Collaborate with the wider support team to meet performance and behavior metrics. You will work with your manager to prioritize and address customer requests for product and service enhancements. You will also communicate transparently with the dedicated customer about service improvements and corrective actions.
* Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding: Screen and interview new hires as the organization scales. You will provide input for the New Hire Training Program and ensure its effective execution for modules delivered by the support team.
* Administrative Oversight: Manage approvals for employee travel bookings and handle Resignation Conversations with departing employees. You will lead these discussions with respect and curiosity, documenting insights to help improve the company.
* Engagement \& Culture: Organize team engagement activities, both in\-person and remote, to foster a positive, collaborative, and high\-performing team culture.


**What We’re Looking For**
* Experience: A minimum of 5 years of progressive leadership experience in a contact center or support environment, with at least 5 years of experience at the manager level.
* Industry Expertise: A minimum of 5 years of experience in the travel industry, with deep knowledge of GDS platforms (Sabre and/or Amadeus).
* Customer Focus: A proven ability to live and breathe customer support, with a commitment to high customer engagement and a passion for resolving complex customer issues.
* Leadership Skills: A track record of building relationships, motivating teams, and acting as a proven mentor. You should have a clear understanding of the challenges facing a fast\-growing company.
* Analytical Abilities: The ability to use a data\-driven approach to identify operational challenges and inform strategic decisions.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, along with strong presentation and facilitation skills.
* Technical Acumen: Familiarity with CRM applications (e.g., Salesforce, Twilio) and contact center applications (e.g., Calabrio, WorkDay).
* Personal Attributes: Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills. You should be able to work independently and as part of a team, and be flexible to work non\-traditional shifts as needed.
* Education: Bachelor's degree preferred.


**What Sets You Apart**
* A reputation as a resolution\-focused leader who champions change and consistently exceeds expectations.
* A proven ability to proactively identify and implement process improvements.
* A passion for developing others and fostering a solutions\-oriented team culture.

 You will be responsible for the end\-to\-end success of programs, with a primary focus on maximizing platform adoption, demonstrating ROI, and mitigating revenue or license attrition risk. You will champion an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology from a management perspective, tracking program health, team velocity, and delivery efficiency.

**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Experience: 15\+ years of experience, predominantly in consulting or strategic advisory roles, managing large\-scale, complex SaaS/CRM program implementations.
* Platform Expertise: Deep expertise in the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including common implementation patterns, integration challenges, custom development, and data migration strategies, and foundational understanding of Agentforce use cases and data cloud dependencies.
* Executive Presence: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to build C\-level relationships, navigate difficult conversations, and negotiate high\-stakes outcomes.
* Account Recovery: Proven experience in strategic account recovery, risk mitigation, and driving platform adoption in complex, at\-risk customer environments.
* Cross\-cultural experience: Must have prior experience working in a multi\-cultural environment with teams and stakeholders geographically spread.
* Team management: Prior experience leading the program pre\-sales \& delivery team by fostering continuous learning and ensuring members are well\-trained, while supporting and driving career growth, personal and team development, well\-being, diversity, and inclusion.
* Methodology: Demonstrated mastery of program management methodologies (Agile, Hybrid) and the ability to apply them to complex enterprise environments, including adapting agile frameworks to support the iterative testing and validation loops unique to generative AI solutions.
* Mindset: A self\-starting, individual contributor mindset with the ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy and influence across matrixed organizations.
* Leadership: Ability to lead a team of consultants in a matrix environment towards a common goal while navigating customer \& internal organizational landscape.
* Education: Degree or equivalent relevant experience.

title: Wealth Manager
description:
**Locations:** 
 Mumbai
 



**Experience:** 
 3–5 years
 



**Industry:** 
 Wealth Management
 



**Company:** 
 Stockify Fintech
 



**Package:** 

 Fixed CTC: Rs. 5\.0 Lakhs per annum \+ Yearly bonus (3\-6 months salary)
 








**About Stockify** 




  






 Stockify is building India's most trusted marketplace for pre\-IPO and unlisted shares, giving HNI and UHNI investors access to exclusive investment opportunities before companies go public. We cover a wide universe of high\-growth unlisted companies across sectors and provide investors with pricing, research and seamless transaction support. Our offices are in Bengaluru, Mumbai, Gurugram and Dubai, and we are expanding our wealth management team aggressively to serve the growing demand from sophisticated investors.
 




  





**About the Role** 




  






 We are hiring experienced Wealth Managers for our Mumbai office. This is a senior client\-facing role where you will manage a portfolio of HNI and UHNI investors, advise them on pre\-IPO and unlisted share investment opportunities, and drive AUM and revenue growth for Stockify. The role combines relationship management, investment advisory and business development in equal measure.
 




  






 This is the right role for a wealth professional who already understands how HNI clients think, has experience with alternative investments or capital markets products, and wants to work in one of the most exciting and high\-growth segments of Indian finance. You will have the full backing of Stockify's research, operations and technology teams, but the relationships you build and the revenue you generate will be very much your own.
 




  





**What You Will Do** 




  




* Build, manage and grow a dedicated book of HNI and UHNI clients who are interested in pre\-IPO and unlisted share investments, with a focus on deepening relationships and increasing AUM over time
* Advise clients on specific unlisted share opportunities available on the Stockify platform, clearly explaining pricing, liquidity considerations, transfer timelines, risk factors and potential upside in a way that is suitable to their financial profile
* Proactively source new HNI leads through your personal network, referrals from existing clients, community events, industry associations and targeted outreach to high\-net\-worth individuals across Mumbai \& west India
* Conduct client meetings, portfolio reviews and investment update calls at regular intervals, keeping clients informed on the performance of their holdings and new opportunities that match their profile
* Cross\-sell Stockify's broader investment offering to existing clients and introduce referrals to the B2B sales team where appropriate
* Work closely with the back office team to ensure smooth and timely execution of all client transactions, including documentation, share transfer and settlement
* Maintain detailed and up\-to\-date records of all client interactions, portfolios, upcoming transactions and follow\-ups in the CRM on a daily basis
* Represent Stockify professionally at investor events, wealth management conferences and community gatherings to build brand visibility and source new relationships



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




  




* Three to six years of experience in wealth management, private banking, investment advisory or relationship management within a financial services organisation
* A strong and demonstrable existing network of HNI clients in Mumbai and west India who trust your investment recommendations and are open to alternative investments
* Prior experience advising clients on alternative investment products such as PMS, AIF, unlisted shares, pre\-IPO investments, structured products or private equity is strongly preferred
* NISM certification in Mutual Funds Distribution or Investment Advisory is preferred; candidates without certification but with a strong track record will also be considered
* Excellent consultative selling skills, with the ability to explain complex investment ideas in a simple and compelling way without oversimplifying the risks involved
* High integrity, a client\-first approach and the professional maturity to build lasting relationships based on trust rather than transactional interactions
* Self\-motivated with the discipline to independently manage a pipeline, set your own outreach schedule and consistently deliver against revenue targets



  





**Compensation and Benefits** 




  




* Fixed CTC: Rs. 5\.0 Lakhs per annum \+ Yearly bonus
* Performance Incentives: Bonus of up to 3 to 6 months of monthly salary, paid based on individual and company performance
* Review Cycle: Performance review at 6 months with potential for salary revision, with earning potential that grows significantly with AUM and revenue performance

title: AVP/Manager - Special projects (Consumer awareness & Skilling)
description:
**About the Job:**



1. Fintech Association for Consumer Empowerment (FACE) is a non\-profit industry association and RBI\-recognised Self\-Regulatory Organisation in the FinTech sector (SRO\-FT). FinTech companies come together at FACE to facilitate consumer\-centric digital financial services that are safe, suitable, and transparent, delivering positive impacts on society and the economy. Please visit our website and refer to the SRO\-FT Framework to understand our work.
2. As an industry association and SRO\-FT, FACE works with the FinTech ecosystem towards innovative, sustainable, and responsible conduct in the FinTech sector, delivering consumer progress and well\-being in line with public policy objectives. The work requires working with a) the supply side, i.e. industry, to improve their employees’ capacity and awareness of conduct and compliance and b) the demand side, i.e. consumers, to improve their understanding of risks, rewards, rights and responsibilities with respect to digital financial services.
3. In this context, we are seeking professionals to join FACE for special projects on consumer awareness of digital financial services and skilling for the FinTech/BFSI sector. The work will involve the complete value chain of the projects, comprising proposal development, partnerships, stakeholder engagement, execution, monitoring, communication and reporting.
4. Location preference is Mumbai, but open to suitable candidates in other locations as well. Position and salary commensurate with work experience and skill sets.



  





**Responsibilities:**



* Identify and develop high\-impact and scalable projects for consumer empowerment\[1] and skilling/training\[2] in line with strategic objectives of FACE.
* Develop proposals, funding plans, and maintain a pipeline of opportunities.
* Ownership of approved projects by converting ideas into detailed proposals with implementation plans, partnership framework, budgets, timelines, milestones, KPIs and measurable outcomes.
* Close engagement with FinTech industry/FACE members, foundations, civil society organisations, educational/training/skilling institutions and certification bodies, implementation agencies, vendors and other ecosystem stakeholders, apex bodies relevant to the project.
* Coordinate internal team, members/stakeholder and implementation partners to monitor progress and risks for timely corrective action and delivery within scope.
* Identify and assess implementation partners/vendors, define deliverables and reporting requirements, support negotiations and agreements, and monitor performance.
* Manage approved projects within agreed scope, timelines and budgets, monitor risks and ensure timely corrective action.
* Prepare project budgets and utilisation plans; track expenditure, review supporting documents and maintain complete documentation, compliance records and audit trails.
* Develop and track KPIs and prepare MIS, dashboards, management reports, and impact reports etc., covering delivery, budgets, reach and outcomes.
* Communication for project activities including events, workshops for dissemination across communication channels, ensuring consistency, timeliness and brand alignment.
* Contribute to other priorities and cross\-functional tasks as required.



  





**Selection Criteria:**



* Graduate/Post\-graduate
* Relevant experience in project management, stakeholder engagement, communications, preferably in the area of FinTech/digital financial services, consumer education, skilling/training ecosystem, grant/CSR funded initiatives projects.
* Understanding of the BFSI and FinTech ecosystem would be a significant advantage.

* Strong project planning, budgeting, and fund management with proficiency in work and productivity software like Google/MS Office.
